name: Arah
title: Arah Island
about: Arah Island is a peaceful tropical escape surrounded by crystal-clear turquoise waters, white sandy beaches and beautiful tropical greenery. It is a perfect destination for travelers looking for relaxation, nature and unforgettable island experiences.

stays.description: Enjoy a comfortable villa with direct access to the beautiful beach.

stays.title: Pool Villa
stays.description: Relax in a private pool surrounded by tropical island scenery.

stays.title: Overwater Villa
stays.description: Stay above the turquoise lagoon with beautiful ocean views.

highlights.title: White Sand Beach
highlights.description: Relax on a beautiful white sandy beach surrounded by turquoise water.

highlights.description: Enjoy the peaceful beauty of the clear blue lagoon.

highlights.title: House Reef
highlights.description: Discover colorful marine life around the island reef.

highlights.title: Sunset Views
